report:
Incident IR-2026-0417, opened 2026-04-17 06:20 UTC by the on call analyst.

At 02:14 UTC the EDR agent on WKS-114, a workstation of the finance department,
quarantined a file named invoice_april.iso.exe. The file had been downloaded
through the browser 90 seconds earlier from a link in a mail that passed the
gateway because the sending domain was on the internal allow list.

At 02:31 UTC the proxy logged three outbound connections from WKS-114 to
91.201.66.8 on port 4444, each of them a few kilobytes in size. The connection
was not blocked; the address was unknown to the threat feed at that time.

At 03:02 UTC the domain controller recorded a successful logon of the account
svc_backup from WKS-114. That service account is meant to run only on the backup
servers and has local administrator rights on all file servers. The password of
the account was last changed 14 months ago and is stored in the credential vault
on srv-pam01.

At 03:40 UTC srv-pam01 answered 220 vault read requests within four minutes,
all of them authenticated with a token issued for svc_backup. The server runs
Devolutions Server 2025.3.15.0 and is therefore affected by CVE-2026-3224.

At 04:05 UTC the file server srv-fs02 logged the creation of 1,400 files with
the extension .locked in the department share of the finance team. The backup
job of the same share had been disabled by the account svc_backup at 03:55 UTC.

At 06:20 UTC the on call analyst isolated WKS-114 from the network and opened
this incident. srv-pam01, srv-fs02 and the backup infrastructure are still
online. No customer facing system has reported an outage so far.
frage: Which systems must be taken off the network first, and in which order should the response team act during the next four hours?
pruefpunkte: names srv-pam01 as affected by CVE-2026-3224
names the service account svc_backup as compromised
mentions rotating or disabling the credentials in the vault
mentions the encrypted share on srv-fs02
gives an order, not only a list of measures
